Fix \(z\in V\) and \(A_z\subseteq V\setminus\{z\}\), and let \(\Sigma^{\star}=I_p+e_z\mathbf 1_{A_z}^{\mathsf T}+\mathbf 1_{A_z}e_z^{\mathsf T}+|A_z|e_ze_z^{\mathsf T}\). For \(j\in V\) and \(P\subseteq V\setminus\{j\}\), write \(r=r_j(P;\Sigma^{\star})\). If \(j=z\), then \(r_q=\mathbf 1\{q\in A_z\}\) for \(q\in P\). If \(j
eq z\) and either \(z
otin P\) or \(j
otin A_z\), then \(r=0\). If \(j\in A_z\) and \(z\in P\), put \(Q=P\setminus\{z\}\) and \(d=1+|A_z\setminus Q|\); then \(r_z=1/d\), \(r_q=-1/d\) for \(q\in A_z\cap Q\), \(r_q=0\) for \(q\in Q\setminus A_z\), and \(\det(\Sigma^{\star}_{P,P})=d\).
